reasoning_traces.think:
These primitives represent foundational architectural limitations in transitioning from isolated development sandboxes to production-scale, asynchronous, and data-driven ecosystems. The core failure mode is that deterministic, review-gated, and offline components cannot inherently handle the stochastic nature of live sports data ingestion, real-time user interactions, and distributed system failures. In GSI, this manifests as static priors that require continuous posterior updates from streaming data; in GSE, it means rigid state machines that lack adaptive exploration. The dualities emerge from the tension between offline validation (safe but brittle) and online learning (fragile but flexible). To avoid anti-collinearity and leakage, we must decouple synchronization points and introduce probabilistic resilience patterns such as bounded retries and conformal anomaly detection.
